scenario: Timer facts are opaque to authors per LTAC.9.4 — the engine uses internal timer facts that are not exposed as user-visible schemas. Pin: a rule with `after` compiles OK and does not require the author to declare a timer schema.
rules_ds:
schema Motion scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Bool mutable

rule auto_off:
    Motion m where m.state == true
->
    log info "motion detected"
    after 5_min:
        log info "auto off"
